lead.kicker: CRICKET • INDIA A • RISING STARS ASIA CUP
lead.headline: 15-YEAR-OLD VAIBHAV SOORYAVANSHI BLASTS 204 OFF 53 BALLS
lead.deck: The teenager set List A records for the fastest century and double century as India A chased 250 against the UAE in just 14.2 overs.
paragraphs: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi reached a century in 28 balls and a double century in 52, finishing with 204 off 53 deliveries and a record 28 sixes. The 15-year-old powered India A to a seven-wicket win over the UAE in the Rising Stars Asia Cup in Doha.
India A completed the 250-run chase in 14.2 overs. Sooryavanshi’s innings rewrote List A records for the fastest hundred and double hundred, and for the most sixes in an innings.

image.alt: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi celebrating a record century for India A.
image.caption: Sooryavanshi made 204 from 53 balls against the UAE. Photo: BCCI / India Today.

sidebarStory.headline: CAUVERY WATER PUMPING SUSPENDED ACROSS BENGALURU TODAY
sidebarStory.subhead: BWSSB’s scheduled 6am–6pm shutdown affects all stages of the Cauvery supply scheme.
paragraphs: The Bengaluru Water Supply and Sewerage Board has halted pumping for emergency repairs and maintenance at T.K. Halli, Harohalli and Tataguni. Supply may be disrupted across the city during the 12-hour work window.
BWSSB advised residents to store enough water in advance. The notice did not specify locality-by-locality restoration times.

image.alt: File photo of pipework at a water pumping station.
image.caption: File photo: pipework at a water pumping station. Photo: The Bengaluru Live.

stories.headline: BLUE LINE TRIALS BEGIN ON OUTER RING ROAD CORRIDOR
paragraphs: Trial runs have begun on the first four stations of the Blue Line Phase 2A, from K.R. Puram towards Doddanekkundi. Passenger service on the 19-km K.R. Puram–Central Silk Board section is targeted for mid-2027, after signalling work and safety certification.

image.alt: Bengaluru Metro Blue Line train at the Phase 2A corridor.
image.caption: Blue Line trial runs have started on the Outer Ring Road section. Photo: India Today / X @krishnabgowda.

stories.headline: POLICE REGISTER FIR OVER THREAT TO DILJIT DOSANJH CONCERT
paragraphs: Bengaluru police have registered an FIR after an email threatened an IED blast at Diljit Dosanjh’s November 29 concert at NICE Grounds. The threat was sent earlier this month to Hubballi-Dharwad civic officials; police are investigating its origin.

image.alt: Singer Diljit Dosanjh performing on stage.
image.caption: Diljit Dosanjh is scheduled to perform in Bengaluru on November 29. File photo: The Indian Express.

stories.headline: FREE SANITARY NAPKINS MANDATORY IN SCHOOLS FOR GIRLS IN CLASSES 6–12
paragraphs: Karnataka has directed government, aided and private schools and pre-university colleges to provide free biodegradable sanitary napkins. Schools have three months to set up menstrual-hygiene corners; officials will inspect compliance.

image.alt: Sanitary napkin vending machine in a girls’ school toilet.
image.caption: Karnataka directed schools to make sanitary napkins freely available and ensure safe disposal. Representative photo: Hindustan Times.

stories.headline: MADURAI HILLTOP PILLAR LEFT UNLIT DESPITE SUPREME COURT ORDER
paragraphs: Tamil Nadu authorities lit the Karthigai Deepam at its customary shrine on Thirupparankundram hill, while leaving the nearby pillar unlit despite a Supreme Court direction for a one-time lamp there. The state had sought review but had no stay by dusk; the court asked the district collector to report within three days.

image.alt: Police and demonstrators at a protest over the unlit Deepathoon pillar in Madurai.
image.caption: The disputed hilltop pillar remained unlit on Tuesday evening. Photo: PTI / The Indian Express.

stories.headline: TWO INDIANS AMONG 11 INJURED IN RIYADH TOWER ATTACK
paragraphs: Two Indian nationals were among 11 people injured when a tower in Riyadh’s King Abdullah Financial District was targeted in an attack attributed by Saudi authorities to Yemen’s Houthi militia. India’s embassy confirmed the injuries and said it was arranging assistance.

stories.headline: CENTRE PLANS WELFARE OUTREACH NETWORK ACROSS 76,000 TRIBAL VILLAGES
paragraphs: The Centre is setting up Adi Sewa Kendras and training local volunteers in nearly 76,000 tribal-dominated villages across 28 states and Union Territories. The programme will track access to health, education, nutrition, housing, livelihoods and social-security schemes.

stories.headline: MAN ARRESTED AFTER BENGALURU WOMAN’S DEATH AT LODGE
paragraphs: A 23-year-old Bengaluru woman died after falling from a lodge window during an incident police are investigating as murder. Her male friend has been arrested; police said the woman’s family alleged he had threatened to share private videos.

stories.headline: JEFFERIES ESTIMATES INDIA’S OCTOBER ACTIVITY GROWTH AT FOUR-YEAR HIGH
paragraphs: India’s economic activity grew an estimated 9% year-on-year in October, its fastest pace in four years, according to a Jefferies indicator. Strong industry and a later festive season supported the reading, while rural demand remained subdued.

stories.headline: HIGH COURT QUASHES FRESH PROBE AGAINST FORMER KSOU VICE-CHANCELLOR
paragraphs: The Karnataka High Court set aside an order for a fresh investigation into a 2012 KSOU computer-and-furniture procurement case and accepted the police closure report. The proceedings against former vice-chancellor K S Rangappa and another petitioner were dropped.

stories.headline: 15-YEAR-OLD SOORYAVANSHI SMASHES 204 OFF 53 BALLS IN WORLD-RECORD CHASE
paragraphs: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi reached a List A century in 28 balls and a double century in 52, finishing with 204 off 53 deliveries and a record 28 sixes. India A chased the UAE’s 250-run target in 14.2 overs to win by seven wickets in the Rising Stars Asia Cup.

image.alt: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi celebrating a record century for India A.
image.caption: Sooryavanshi made 204 from 53 balls against the UAE. Photo: BCCI / India Today.

stories.headline: PRIYANSH ARYA’S 181 SETS NEW INDIAN T20 RECORD
paragraphs: Delhi captain Priyansh Arya hit 181 from 68 balls against Tamil Nadu in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, the highest T20 score by an Indian and second-highest in the men’s format. Delhi won by 116 runs.

stories.headline: GUKESH AND SINDAROV DRAW OPENING WORLD TITLE GAME
paragraphs: Defending champion D Gukesh and challenger Javokhir Sindarov drew the first game of their 2026 World Championship match in Geneva. Game two is scheduled for Wednesday, November 25.
